description: Generate post concepts and a reviewable draft candidate from BAMF unified creator context. Defaults to LinkedIn; pass platform=x for X-native hooks, threads, and growth-focused drafts. If the brief involves recent news, trends, benchmarks, or exact numbers, pass research_policy/source_urls/research_notes or run bamf.run_research first. If the brief needs creator POV, pass mini_interview_answers or ask up to three focused questions. post_type and media_plan formats are textual recommendations only; this tool does not generate image, video, audio, or other media assets. This creates an async job only and does not create, schedule, or publish a post.

evidence_needs.description: Specific facts, benchmarks, claims, or questions the draft should verify or use.

interview_policy.description: auto asks mini-interview questions when authentic creator POV is missing.

mini_interview_answers.description: Creator answers keyed by question or topic. Use for real stories, opinions, proof, and voice.

research_notes.description: Concise source-backed findings from web research, or saved research.

research_policy.description: auto runs current research when the brief has fresh-data/news/benchmark signals; required forces it; off disables it.

source_urls.description: Source URLs to synthesize and weave into the draft when useful.

template_category.description: Optional category hint. BAMF still matches multiple templates by semantic, lexical, style, performance, recency, and diversity signals.

name: bamf.generate_post
